items.title: Insurance Age Broker Expo Bites Episode Five unavailable
items.summary: Insurance Age reported that an episode featuring Acrisure UK's Steve Padley could not load due to technical issues.

items.title: Oneglobal and Asiste partner to expand Peruvian re/insurance services
items.summary: Independent Peruvian insurance broker Asiste Corredores de Seguros has formed a strategic partnership with international reinsurance intermediary Oneglobal Corredores de Reaseguros S.A.

items.title: NormanMax Syndicate 3939 reports 9M gross written premium rise to $53.8m
items.summary: NormanMax Syndicate 3939 has more than doubled its gross written premium for the first nine months of 2026 and secured approval for $65 million in 2027 capacity.

items.title: RBNZ warns on private credit risks as non-bank lending grows
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand has highlighted rising global financial stability risks and vulnerabilities within the non-bank lending and private credit sectors.

items.title: Advantage Insurance wins preliminary ruling over FCA authorisation in credit hire dispute
items.summary: A Glasgow sheriff has ruled that a motorist cannot claim loss of use while driving a replacement vehicle, in a case testing whether credit hire firms must hold FCA authorisation.

items.title: iM Global Partner launches iMGP Trends fund for managed futures access
items.summary: iM Global Partner has introduced the iMGP Trends fund to provide European investors with exposure to managed futures strategies.
